halfLife.notes: Twice-daily dosing required. Renally cleared — dose adjustment essential in renal impairment. No hepatic metabolism — no CYP interactions. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.notes: No active metabolite. Renally excreted unchanged.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: No CYP interactions — sulpiride is renally cleared unchanged. This makes it unusual among antipsychotics and simplifies polypharmacy management. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Minimal weight gain, minimal metabolic burden. One of the most metabolically neutral antipsychotics. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Selective D2/D3 antagonism — rebound psychosis risk on abrupt cessation. Taper preferred. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Twice-daily dosing essential due to short half-life. Avoid in renal impairment — renally cleared. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
specialConsiderations: No hepatic metabolism — safe in hepatic impairment; adjust dose in renal impairment.
Very high prolactin elevation — most potent prolactin-raising antipsychotic; monitor for galactorrhoea, amenorrhoea, sexual dysfunction.
Antiemetic effect at low doses (50–100 mg) — used for nausea and gastroparesis in some settings.
No CYP interactions — useful in complex polypharmacy.
